summary: Adds a Question Bank to every Lesson from Week 2 to Week 16 (Week 1 already had them), so every Lesson now has a Lesson Quiz. Each bank was researched against the official docs for its tools, and the 196 Materials those Questions cite are added. Five Lessons and one Milestone are revised where the field has moved: MCP revision 2026-07-28 (no `initialize` handshake, Multi Round-Trip Requests, Sampling, Roots and Logging deprecated), AI SDK 6's deprecation of `generateObject`, App Runner closing to new customers in favour of ECS Express Mode, and Claude's newer Messages API endpoint on Bedrock. Seven Materials whose docs moved get their current URLs.

changes.what: Added a 12-Question Bank (8 multiple choice, 4 written) over five Concepts: hints are static, `X | None` and `Literal`, TypedDict vs dataclass vs Pydantic, Protocols, and generics. Added the typing, mypy protocols and mypy generics docs to the Lesson's Materials.
changes.why: The Lesson had no Question Bank, so it couldn't be quizzed. The Questions follow the current Python typing docs and mypy docs, including Python 3.12 type-parameter syntax and `--strict`'s flag set.

changes.what: Added a Question Bank: 12 Questions on MCP hosts, clients and servers, server primitives, client features, JSON-RPC messages, and transports (pinned to MCP spec revision 2026-07-28). Revised the topics: capability negotiation is now per-request protocol version and capabilities plus `server/discover`, a new topic covers Multi Round-Trip Requests, and Sampling, Roots and Logging are marked deprecated.
changes.why: The Lesson had no Question Bank, so Learners had nothing to practise its topics and exercise with. MCP revision 2026-07-28 removed the `initialize` handshake, made every request carry its protocol version and client capabilities, added `server/discover`, replaced server-initiated requests with Multi Round-Trip Requests, and deprecated Roots, Sampling and Logging.

changes.what: Added a Question Bank: 12 Questions on generateText, streamText and structured output, tools with Zod schemas, multi-step calls and stop conditions, and switching providers. Revised the topics: structured output is taught as `generateText` with `output: Output.object(...)` instead of `generateObject`. Added the AI SDK structured data, tool calling, loop control and provider management pages to the Lesson's Materials.
changes.why: The Lesson had no Question Bank. Written for AI SDK 7 (current); it teaches that generateObject is deprecated since AI SDK 6 and that stepCountIs became isStepCount in AI SDK 7. The AI SDK 6 migration guide deprecates `generateObject` and `streamObject` in favour of `generateText` and `streamText` with `Output.object()`.

changes.what: Added a Question Bank: 11 Questions on Lambda's 15-minute limit, cold starts, choosing between Lambda, Fargate, App Runner (now ECS Express Mode) and EC2, and containers as the unit of deployment. Revised the topics: the compute comparison is now Lambda vs ECS on Fargate (including ECS Express Mode) vs EC2, noting App Runner is closed to new customers. Added the Lambda quotas, Fargate, ECS Express Mode and App Runner availability pages to the Lesson's Materials.
changes.why: The Lesson had no Question Bank, so it had no Lesson Quiz. Questions reflect that App Runner closed to new customers on 30 April 2026. AWS closed App Runner to new customers and recommends Amazon ECS Express Mode, which provisions a Fargate service with a load balancer and auto scaling from a container image.

changes.what: Added a Question Bank: 11 Questions on S3, RDS and Secrets Manager, runtime secrets, Bedrock model access and inference profiles, the Converse API, and Bedrock vs calling the provider directly. Revised the topics: added Claude's legacy `InvokeModel`/`Converse` integration vs the newer Messages API endpoint on Bedrock, with a 12th Question on it. Added the Converse API and both Claude-on-Bedrock pages to the Lesson's Materials.
changes.why: The Lesson had no Question Bank, so it had no Lesson Quiz. Anthropic now documents `InvokeModel` and `Converse` with ARN-versioned model IDs as the legacy Bedrock integration (Opus 4.6 and earlier); Opus 4.7 and later use the Messages API at `/anthropic/v1/messages` on Bedrock.

changes.what: Retitled to deploy to ECS Express Mode or ECS on Fargate instead of App Runner, and added the ECS Express Mode and Fargate pages to its Materials.
changes.why: AWS closed App Runner to new customers and recommends ECS Express Mode for App Runner-style deployments.

changes.what: Added a Question Bank: 11 Questions on sandboxed execution, just-in-time repository context, a test-driven loop with human review, and secrets, permissions and prompt injection. Added Claude Code best practices and GitHub's protected branches page to the Lesson's Materials.
changes.why: The Lesson had no Question Bank, so it had no Lesson Quiz. Its Questions on test-driven agent loops and required human review cite those pages.
